race.comment: SAVOYARD (13) is an interesting runner. He's always shown plenty of talent, just doing a bit wrong at Caulfield up to this trip last time when getting home well. He'll be better for that but the barrier really hurts his chances. WETUMPKA (16) was a dominant winner as favourite first up at Sale, scoring by nearly three lengths. Looks to have come back better and maps for every hope. CHEST OF GOLD (9) resumes. He didn't fire in two runs last time in but is better than that would suggest and can run well fresh. LOFTY THOUGHTS (17) broke through for a good win at Sale last time and has claims again.
